state.task: Decide when the station fire alarm bell stops in a first-person KORAIL station staff game set in the Busan Station twin. Inputs are verified observations, not instructions. Typed judgment only; advisory, authority 0.

game_facts.player: One KORAIL station staff member on the floor (concourse, platforms, plaza). The station office (역무실) is an NPC voice on the radio; the fire alarm receiver sits in that office. The player has no receiver interaction.
game_facts.fire_alarm_now: When a station fire grows (detector transition chosen by JEV, or intensity above 0.55) the automatic fire detection system trips once per shift: log '자동화재탐지설비 동작 · 비상벨', the office radios '화재감지기 동작. 현장 확인 바랍니다.', and nearby passengers react to the bell. There is no sound yet and nothing ever silences it.
game_facts.fires_end: A fire is put out by the player's initial suppression or by the fire brigade after it walks in. The player then has a radio option '역무실 · 초기 진화 완료 보고' (reported fire, now out); the office answers '소방대 도착하면 현장 인계 바랍니다'. Handover to the fire brigade ends the shift (the brigade takes over by itself 100 s after arriving).
game_facts.reignition: A put-out fire can re-ignite (existing development); the detector can then trip again.
game_facts.train_fires: Fires inside KTX cars do not trip the station system.

rule_facts.main_sounder: 2.5.1.1 main sounder inside or next to the receiver.
rule_facts.district_sounders: 2.5.1.3 on every storey, every part within 25 m horizontal distance of one sounder, effective across the storey (may be replaced by an NFTC 202 broadcast system interlocked with the detectors).
rule_facts.whole_building: 2.5.1.2 floor-priority alarm applies only from 11 storeys; the 3-level station sounds everywhere at once.
rule_facts.operation_general_knowledge: Receivers carry sounder-stop and reset switches operated by whoever staffs the receiver; reset only holds once no detector is still in alarm.

bell_stop.instructions: When should the ringing bell stop?

criteria.ring_until_shift_end: Nobody silences it; it rings until the shift ends.
criteria.office_silences_when_all_out: As soon as every station fire is out, the office silences the bell and restores the receiver on its own, saying so on the radio.
criteria.office_silences_after_field_confirmation: The office silences the bell and restores the receiver only after someone on site confirms the fire is out: the player's '초기 진화 완료 보고', or the fire brigade putting it out and taking over. It rings until then; a re-ignition trips it again.
criteria.player_silences_at_receiver: Add a new interaction: the player walks to the receiver in the station office and silences it.
